items.title: 30.6 1H NMR se molecule ki mumkin banawat maloom karna (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 30.6 with Example 30.2 (PDF 211).

blocks.text: Kisi na-maloom compound ka structure us ke ¹H NMR spectrum ko parh kar bhi maloom kiya ja sakta hai. Is ke liye neeche di gayi ahem maloomat ko paheli (puzzle) ki tarah jora jata hai. Structure maloom karne ke liye:

items: Spectrum mein peaks ginein. Peaks ki tadaad = protons ke environments ki tadaad.
Har peak ki chemical shift se functional groups pehchanein (data table, Table 30.1, use karein).
Peak ke area se har peak ke hydrogen atoms ki asal tadaad maloom karein (yani har environment mein kitne H hain).
Batne ka namoona dekh kar saath wale protons ginein: sub-peaks ki tadaad = n + 1, yani n = sub-peaks ki tadaad – 1.
Yeh sab maloomat jor kar poora molecular structure banayein.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne pehle step mein 'No. of peaks = No of protons' chhapa hai. Sahi yeh hai ke peaks ki tadaad protons ke environments (barabar protons ke sets) ki tadaad hai, protons ki nahi; har environment ke protons peak ke area se milte hain.

blocks.title: Misal 30.2
blocks.problem: Aik ester ka ¹H NMR spectrum neeche diya gaya hai. Ester ka structure maloom karein.

blocks.alt: Misal 30.2 ke ester ka 1H NMR spectrum: absorption of energy banam chemical shift, delta ppm, 6 se 0. Taqreeban 3.9 par chaar chhoti sub-peaks (2H), taqreeban 2.1 par aik lambi akeli peak (3H), taqreeban 1.3 par teen sub-peaks (3H), aur 0 par TMS ki chhoti peak.
blocks.caption: Misal 30.2: aik ester ka 1H NMR spectrum (Misal 30.2 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 2H wala quartet (3.9 ppm) O ke saath CH₂ hai, 3H singlet (taqreeban 2.1 – 2.2 ppm) C=O ke saath CH₃, aur 3H triplet (1.3 ppm) CH₂ ke saath CH₃. Spectrum mein 3.9 wali peak ke chaar sub-peaks saaf nazar aate hain (quartet).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ka table 3.9 ppm wale signal ko 'doublet' aur '2-1 = 1' likhta hai. Oxygen ke saath wale CH₂ ke parosi CH₃ mein teen protons hain, is liye yeh quartet hai: 4 – 1 = 3, jaisa spectrum bhi dikhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethyl group (-CH₂CH₃) kaun sa jora (pair) signals deta hai?
blocks.explanation: Quartet (CH₂, area 2, CH₃ se bata hua) aur triplet (CH₃, area 3, CH₂ se bata hua).

items: Peaks = environments; chemical shift = group; area = H ki tadaad; batna = parosi protons (n = sub-peaks – 1).
